---
title: "Running Scenarios"
---

`run_scenarios` takes a list of settings and campaigns and returns one row for each, with the
scalar summaries and the full trajectories side by side. It derives `dn0` from the net mix and
the resistance level, inverts whatever transmission measure was supplied, applies any
mosquito-density adjustment, and runs the emulator over the 157-window grid.

It is exported from `estimint` but drives both packages. Nothing is imported from `stateMINT`
directly.

::: {.chapter-outline}
- [Running scenarios](run-scenarios.qmd) — `Scenario`, `EirTarget`, and the returned columns.
- [A scenario grid](scenario-grid.qmd) — five campaigns against one baseline.
- [Trajectories and cases](comparing.qmd) — prevalence, clinical incidence, and cases averted.
- [Exporting results](exporting.qmd) — CSV, and a tidy table R can read.
:::

Two ways of driving the API run through the pages that follow, the first varying every axis at
once, with all three input modes, all four net products, both seasonality settings, and
mosquito-density adjustments in either direction. The second holds one setting fixed and varies
only the campaign, so that any difference between the rows is caused by the campaign and nothing
else, that setting being under-5 prevalence 0.45, pyrethroid resistance 0.30, pyrethroid-only
nets at 0.70 coverage, `Q0 = 0.85`, `phi_bednets = 0.80`, perennial transmission, and neither IRS
nor LSM in place. It is the same district throughout.
